name: Spotify
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://www.lifeatspotify.com/jobs (2026-10-20T00:14Z) showed '73 jobs in all locations in all categories in all job types' (its data: api.lifeatspotify.com/wp-json/animal/v1/job/search, 73 entries). Spotify's Lever hosted board https://jobs.lever.co/spotify listed 82 postings, equal to the API.
notes: lifeatspotify.com is an edited WordPress mirror of Lever. It leaves out 7 Lever postings (created May to Oct 2026, while newer ones do appear, so this is not sync lag). It also merges or splits same-title multi-city postings differently: 82 Lever postings, 73 site entries. Lever is complete. Site slugs are not Lever ids.
